extracted.name: Instant Oatmeal Recipe
extracted.description: Our DIY Instant Oatmeal Packets are so easy, quick, and healthier than store-bought! Customize each packet with endless flavor combinations, making breakfast a breeze!
ingredient_lines: 1/4 cup brown sugar (, (or omit sweetener and mix in sugar, honey, or maple syrup after cooking))
instruction_lines: Mix dry oatmeal ingredients together. Divide heaping 1/3 cup portions between 12 snack bags or small containers. Add desired mix-ins (see ideas in Notes). Label bags. Store in a cool dry place for up to several months.
Hot Water Method: Add oatmeal packet contents to a bowl and stir in 2/3 cup boiling water. Rest for a few minutes, until most of the water has absorbed, before eating.
Microwave Method: Add oatmeal packet contents to a bowl and stir in ¾ cup water (or use milk for a creamier option). Cook for 1 or 1.5 minutes, until most of the liquid has absorbed.
Serve topped with additional sweetener, if needed, and a splash of milk.
